L.A. CARE BOARD OF GOVERNORS MEETING
April 2, 2026 ● 10:00 AM
L.A. Care Health Plan
Lobby Conference Rooms 1305, 1307 & 1309
1200 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017

About L.A. Care Health Plan
Mission
L.A. Care’s mission is to provide access to quality health care for Los Angeles County's vulnerable and low‑income communities and residents and to support the safety net required to achieve that purpose.
Overview
Committed to the promotion of accessible, affordable and high quality health care, L.A. Care Health Plan (Local Initiative Health Authority of Los Angeles County) is an independent local public agency created by the State of California to provide health coverage to low-income Los Angeles County residents. Serving more than 2.6 million members in four product lines, L.A. Care is the nation’s largest publicly operated health plan.
L.A. Care Health Plan is governed by a 13-member Board of Governors representing specific stakeholder groups, including consumer members, physicians, federally qualified health centers, children’s health care providers, local hospitals and the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services.
Health Coverage
 Medi-Cal – In addition to offering a direct Medi-Cal line of business, L.A. Care works with two subcontracted health plans to provide coverage to Medi-Cal members. These partners are Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan.
 L.A. Care Covered™ – As a state selected Qualified Health Plan, L.A. Care provides the opportunity for all members of a family to receive health coverage under one health plan in the Covered California state exchange.
 L.A. Care Medicare Plus (HMO D-SNP) – L.A. Care Medicare Plus provides complete care that coordinates Medicare and Medi-Cal benefits for Los Angeles County seniors and people with disabilities.
 PASC-SEIU Homecare Workers Health Care Plan – L.A. Care provides health coverage to Los Angeles County’s In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) workers.

Health Equity and Community Impact
It takes more than health care coverage to build healthy communities. L.A. Care recognizes that non-medical factors can significantly impact health outcomes. It is estimated that 50-80 percent of health outcomes are based on social, economic and environmental factors. To ensure healthy communities, it’s critical to address basic needs like food, housing, education, transportation and employment – often referred to as social needs, or social drivers of health.
L.A. Care supports its members health and social needs through a variety of targeted activities: Community Health Investment Fund (CHIF), Elevating the Safety Net, and Blue Shield Promise Community Resource Centers.
Regional Community Advisory Committees are eight councils made up of L.A. Care members, doctors, nurses, and community-based organizations who bring the voice of their communities directly to the Board of Governors.

AGENDA
BOARD OF GOVERNORS MEETING
Thursday, April 2, 2026, 10:00 AM
1. Approve today’s agenda
2. Public Comment
3. Approve Consent Agenda Items
   - March 10, 2026 Meeting Minutes
   - Internal Audit Charter (EXE 100)
   - Regional Advisory Committee Membership (ECA 100)
4. Leadership Reports (Board Vice Chair, CEO, Performance Monitoring)
5. Board Issues (Consolidation of PRAC and TAC)
6. Public Advisory Committee Reports
7. Board Committee Reports
8. Public Comment on Closed Session Items
9-16. Closed Session (Trade Secrets, Contract Rates, Anticipated Litigation, Existing Litigation, Real Property Negotiators, CEO Performance Evaluation)
Adjournment
Next meeting: Thursday, May 7, 2026 at 10:00 AM

[DRAFT Minutes - March 10, 2026]
Board Chair Ilan Shapiro, MD called the meeting to order at 10:03 A.M.
Major discussions included concern about liability waivers for RCAC volunteers, IHSS workers receiving inadequate coverage, and the retirement of Linda Greenfeld (Chief Products Officer) and Tom MacDougall (Chief Technology & Information Officer).
Melanie Fontes Rainer presented the Flightpath Balanced Scorecard KPIs for 2026, focusing on claims effectiveness, encounter data timeliness, provider portal adoption, and primary care engagement.
Financial reports indicated total plan membership at 2.6 million as of December 2025, with a YTD net surplus of $320 million.
Public comments were heard regarding hospital discharge policies (Dorothy Lawry) and meeting accessibility (Deaka MacLain).

[CEO Report - April 02, 2026]
Martha Santana-Chin introduced Aliza Arjoyan as the new Chief Network Strategy and Engagement Officer. Reported on the retirement of Cherie Compartore (Senior Director of Government Affairs).
Keep L.A. Covered Update: Advancing efforts to preserve coverage in light of H.R. 1 and state budget constraints. Soft launching Coverage Champions program with 120 volunteers.
Board Motion: L.A. Care's support for the Los Angeles County Essential Services Restoration Act (temporary half-cent sales tax) on the June 2026 ballot to address $1 trillion in federal health care spending reductions under H.R. 1.

[Government Relations - California Legislative Session 2025-26]
California is navigating a projected $18 billion budget deficit. Federal impacts include significant focus on H.R. 1 ('One Big Beautiful Act') which has already led to 120,000 Los Angeles County residents losing Medi-Cal coverage, including 27,000 children.
Legislative themes: Administrative Burden (AB 2431 - downcoding), Coverage (AB 1900 - single payer), Rates (AB 2327 - subcontractor rates), and Workforce (AB 2391 - nursing graduate support).

[Performance Monitoring - March 2026]
Utilization Management: MCLA timelines strong at 98-99%. DSNP below 95% due to new CMS turnaround times. Transportation (Call the Car): All Town Transportation activated to support timely hospital discharges. Claims Operations: 95% of claims processed within 30 calendar days standard.

[Board Issues]
Approved consolidation of Provider Relations Advisory Committee (PRAC) and Technical Advisory Committee (TAC) into the Provider Relations and Technical Advisory Committee (PR&TAC). Member roster includes Sameer Amin, MD, Rishi Manchanda, MD, and other healthcare experts.
